Delegate Briefing | Your Party

# PARTICIPANT BREIFING FOR FOUNDING CONFERENCE 2025

# Founding Your Party: How It Works

Over the last three months, we have done something big, bold and new: built a genuinely democratic party from scratch, one with well over 50,000 members. And we’re just getting started. 

We have held assemblies and rallies across every nation of Britain, from Falmouth to Edinburgh, Colchester to Cardiff, with thousands upon thousands attending. At these meetings, Your Party has come to life.

In assemblies and online via our digital crowd-editing tool, we asked Your Party members to help draft our four founding documents – our Political Statement, Constitution, Rules, and Organisational Strategy – the foundation stones on which this party will be built. These documents evolved in line with members’ views, with the big questions put forward for debate at Conference.

The Founding Conference will be the peak of this common project, the moment where members debate and agree our structures & programme, and the party is officially born.

And we’re doing Conference differently, too. Participants have been chosen by lottery to ensure a representative and inclusive conference, the first time the sortition has been used in this way in British politics. All members will be able to vote online, whether they are in the conference hall or not – unlike Labour, we’re not scared of democracy.

There will be a livestream of Conference proceedings, available via our YouTube.

## Votes this weekend

Keep an eye on yourparty.uk/vote for a full breakdown of the votes happening, which are taking place via the Your Party app and our digital members’ portal. All Your Party members will be able to vote, not just those at Conference, as we empower our mass membership.

Members will vote on each of the four founding papers, which will establish the party’s structures, programme, and strategy. You can read more about the process up to this point here, and the standing orders for the Conference here.

# Logistics

## Address: 

ACC Liverpool Exhibition Centre, Kings Dock, Liverpool Waterfront, L3 4FP.

For satnav use L3 4BX. On-site 24-hour pay and display parking is available in the Kings Dock Car Park.

## Passes

All those who have been successful in sortition and have registered for their conference pass will be able to pick up them up at the ACC Exhibition Centre during: 

- 18:00 – 20:00 PM Friday 
- 08:30 – 10:00 AM Saturday and Sunday

A pass will then be issued in a lanyard, which should be worn at all times.

Please note:

- Have your QR code on your phone ready, the team will be on hand to assist you if required.
- If you have access needs make yourself known to a steward who will bring you to the front of the queue
- All bags that are to be brought into the conference hall must be smaller than an A4 piece of paper.

## Facilities & Amenities

There is a dedicated cloakroom next to the main entrance, and there will be an overflow cloakroom. Please DO NOT bring any bags over A4 size as items are left at your own risk. 

Toilets, including accessible toilets, are available throughout the venue and these are all clearly signposted. 

Food and drinks

There is a selection of food and drinks available to purchase during the event in the main catering hall.

Outside, there is a speciality coffee van open 08:00 – 14:30 and A taste of Liverpool serving hearty Scouse and loaded fries from 12:30 – 14:30 daily, plus 18:00 – 20:30 on Saturday.

Vegetarian, vegan & halal options available. Please note the ACC is a cashless venue and takes card payments only. 

Stalls & Exhibition Area

A range of campaigns and organisations from across our movement will have stalls outside the main conference hall. 

Fringe Spaces

Fringes will take place either in the conference hall during lunchtime on Saturday and Sunday and in Hall B on Saturday evening. 

Quiet, Prayer, and Wellbeing Spaces

To ensure everyone feels welcome and supported, we are providing a dedicated Prayer Room in the northwest corner.

Standing Orders Room

For anyone who would like to discuss and debate the amendments which will be debated throughout the conference, there will be a Standing Orders Room outside the Conference Hall.

# Accessibility

The venue is fully accessible. The hall layout includes wide central aisles, ramps, and multiple step-free access points. All rooms are accessible from the main walkway perimeter. There are access stewards on hand for any access needs. 

A dedicated First Aid Room is located halfway down The Atrium; there are trained first-aiders on site throughout the event. If you have any issues please contact a volunteer or stewards. 

We will have a reserved accessible seating area in the conference hall for wheelchair users and disabled attendees. All accessible attendees will have priority to enter the conference.

There will be sign language interpretation during all conference sessions.

Fire Exits

Clearly marked Fire Exits run along all four sides of the hall please follow the instructions of the stewards and venue staff in case of emergency. 

## Conduct & Conditions

- All attendees are asked to wear their lanyard visible at all times. 

- Serious breaches of these conditions, or any abusive conduct, may result in ejection from the arena. Entry is wholly at the discretion of Your Party.

# Programme 

Note that the full programme will be available on the day.

Saturday 29 Nov 2025: 

- 08:30 AM Doors Open
- 10:00 AM Conference Starts
- 11: 00 AM Debate 1: Political Statement
- 12:30 PM – 2:00 PM Lunch Break
- 12:45 PM – 1:45 PM Fringe Event: Economy for The Many

- 2:00 PM Conference Resumes 
- 2:25 PM Debate 2: Constitution 
- 5:00 PM – 6:00 PM Fringe Event: Organising Workers to Win
- 7:00 PM – 9:30 PM Music for The Many

Sunday 30 Nov 2025: 

- 08:30 AM Doors Open
- 10:00 AM Conference Starts
- 11: 00 AM Debate 3: Organisational Strategy
- 12:30 PM – 2:00 PM Lunch Break
- 12:45 PM – 1:45 PM Fringe Event: Palestine and International Solidarity

- 2:00 PM Conference Resumes 
- 2:25 PM Debate 2: Standing Orders
- 5:00 PM Close of Conference
